name: Sped Methodology
description: Methodology in Special Education and Inclusive Education covering curriculum design, adaptation, teaching strategies, assessment, and specialized interventions across diverse disability categories for the DSC exam.

topics.name: Methodology for Intellectual Disability (ID)
topics.description: Curriculum development, adaptations, instructional strategies, and behavioral interventions for children with Intellectual Disability.

subtopics.name: Curriculum Design and Development for ID
subtopics.description: Foundational concepts, principles, types, and levels of curriculum planning for students with Intellectual Disability.

concepts.name: Curriculum Concepts and Principles for ID
concepts.description: Meaning, definition, core concepts, and fundamental principles of curriculum design tailored for children with ID.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand the core principles and conceptual framework of designing curriculum for students with ID.

concepts.name: Types and Approaches of Curriculum Designing
concepts.description: Exploration of standard curriculum design approaches and types suitable for special education.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify and differentiate various approaches and types of curriculum design used in special education.

concepts.name: Curriculum across Educational Levels
concepts.description: Curriculum structure at Secondary, Pre-vocational, and Vocational levels for learners with ID.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze curriculum structure and transition planning from secondary to vocational training for ID.

subtopics.name: Adaptation, Teaching Strategies, and Interventions for ID
subtopics.description: Curricular adaptation techniques, multisensory teaching strategies, TLM preparation, and behavioral management.

concepts.name: Curricular, Academic, and Co-curricular Adaptations
concepts.description: Needs and methods for adaptation, accommodation, and modification in pre-academic, academic, and co-curricular subjects.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply accommodation and modification techniques across school subjects and activities for students with ID.

concepts.name: Teaching Strategies, TLM, and Multisensory Approaches
concepts.description: Methodologies, teaching-learning materials (TLM), and multisensory approaches for teaching concepts to ID students.
concepts.learning_objective: Select and utilize appropriate teaching strategies and multisensory TLM for learners with ID.

concepts.name: Intervention for Maladaptive Behaviour
concepts.description: Assessment and behavioral intervention strategies to handle maladaptive behaviors in the classroom.
concepts.learning_objective: Plan and execute behavioral intervention strategies to address maladaptive behaviors in ID.

topics.name: Methodology for Hearing Impairment (HI)
topics.description: Curriculum adaptation, literacy development, auditory training, speech interventions, and technology for children with Hearing Impairment.

subtopics.name: Curriculum Designing, Adaptation, and Evaluation for HI
subtopics.description: Models, steps, adaptation processes, and evaluation frameworks for students with HI.

concepts.name: HI Curriculum Models and Design Steps
concepts.description: Concepts, types, models, and systematic steps for designing curriculum tailored to HI needs.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the curriculum design models and steps required for hearing impaired learners.

concepts.name: Curricular Adaptation Process for HI
concepts.description: Principles, need assessment, and process of adapting content, TLM, instruction, and examinations.
concepts.learning_objective: Execute need assessment and adapt content, instructional materials, and exams for HI students.

concepts.name: Curricular Evaluation for HI
concepts.description: Factors, methods, and evaluation tools used to evaluate curricular progress for HI learners.
concepts.learning_objective: Evaluate student learning outcomes in HI using specialized tools and methods.

subtopics.name: Literacy, Communication, and Assistive Technology for HI
subtopics.description: Intervention strategies for language, speech, auditory training, AVT, and technology implementation.

concepts.name: Literacy Skills Development: Reading and Writing
concepts.description: Strategies to build reading and writing literacy in children with hearing loss.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply specialized methods to foster reading and writing skills in HI students.

concepts.name: Early Intervention, Auditory Training, and AVT
concepts.description: Early detection strategies, Auditory Verbal Therapy (AVT), and auditory training approaches.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand early intervention techniques, AVT, and auditory training practices.

concepts.name: Speech and Communication Teaching Strategies
concepts.description: Speech intervention techniques and language teaching strategies tailored for hearing impairment.
concepts.learning_objective: Implement effective speech and language development interventions in HI education.

concepts.name: Assistive Technology for Speech and Education in HI
concepts.description: Technological devices and software facilitating speech management and accessible education.
concepts.learning_objective: Integrate appropriate educational and speech technology to support HI learners.

topics.name: Methodology for Visual Impairment (VI)
topics.description: Functional academics, Expanded Core Curriculum, Braille instruction, orientation & mobility, and adaptive devices for children with Visual Impairment.

subtopics.name: Curriculum Planning, IEP, and Pedagogical Strategies for VI
subtopics.description: Lesson planning, IEP writing, Expanded Core Curriculum, and inclusive pedagogical strategies.

concepts.name: Functional Academics and Independent Living Skills
concepts.description: Curriculum approaches to teach functional academic concepts and essential independent living skills.
concepts.learning_objective: Design instruction for functional academics and independent daily living skills for VI.

concepts.name: Expanded Core Curriculum (ECC) and IEP Writing
concepts.description: Components of Expanded Core Curriculum and formulation of Individualized Education Programs for VI.
concepts.learning_objective: Draft IEPs and implement Expanded Core Curriculum for students with visual impairment.

concepts.name: Pedagogical Strategies and Multisensory Approaches
concepts.description: Cooperative learning, peer tutoring, reflective teaching, and tactile/multisensory instruction for VI.
concepts.learning_objective: Employ cooperative and multisensory pedagogical strategies in teaching visually impaired students.

subtopics.name: Specific Skills, Braille, Mobility, and Assistive Devices
subtopics.description: Teaching Braille, Orientation & Mobility, sensory training, adaptive physical education, and interventions.

concepts.name: Teaching Braille, Sign Language, and Concept Formation
concepts.description: Techniques for concept formation, teaching Braille (devices/types), and sign language integration.
concepts.learning_objective: Utilize Braille devices and teaching methods to facilitate literacy and concept formation.

concepts.name: Orientation & Mobility, Sensory Training, and Assistive Devices
concepts.description: Methods for teaching orientation and mobility (O&M), sensory training, and training on latest assistive devices.
concepts.learning_objective: Instruct VI students in orientation, mobility, sensory utilization, and assistive technology.

concepts.name: Special Educator Roles, Interventions, and Physical Education
concepts.description: Role of special educators in mediated learning, adaptive TLM, interventions for lately blinded students, and adapted physical education.
concepts.learning_objective: Prepare adaptive TLM, design interventions for late blindness, and adapt physical education activities.

topics.name: Methodology for Specific Learning Disability (SLD)
topics.description: Instructional planning, differentiation, specialized academic interventions, processing deficit supports, and evaluation tools for children with SLD.

subtopics.name: Curriculum Design, Planning, and Assessment for SLD
subtopics.description: Curriculum hierarchies, types of curriculum, accommodations, and rubric-based assessment.

concepts.name: Types of Curriculum and Hierarchies in SLD
concepts.description: Principles of core, collateral, support, and hidden curriculum, alongside instructional hierarchies.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between core, collateral, support, and hidden curriculum types in SLD education.

concepts.name: Instructional Planning and Differentiation Strategies
concepts.description: Adapting, modifying, accommodating instruction, and designing classroom differentiation strategies.
concepts.learning_objective: Plan differentiated instruction and apply accommodations for SLD students in inclusive classrooms.

concepts.name: Assessment Tools and Evaluation Techniques for SLD
concepts.description: Evaluation tools including rubrics, grading adaptations, and specialized marking schemes.
concepts.learning_objective: Construct rubrics and assessment procedures appropriate for evaluating students with SLD.

subtopics.name: Academic Interventions and Technology for SLD
subtopics.description: Interventions in reading, writing, mathematics, processing deficits, life skills, and ICT engagement.

concepts.name: Strategies for Reading, Word Recognition, and Fluency
concepts.description: Methods to improve word recognition, reading fluency, and reading comprehension across subjects.
concepts.learning_objective: Implement evidence-based strategies to remediate reading, fluency, and comprehension difficulties.

concepts.name: Interventions for Handwriting, Spelling, and Written Expression
concepts.description: Remediation strategies for graphomotor skills, dysgraphia, spelling patterns, and written composition.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply targeted instructional interventions for handwriting, spelling, and written expression.

concepts.name: Interventions for Mathematics, Processing Deficits, and Life Skills
concepts.description: Educational techniques addressing dyscalculia, cognitive processing deficits, life skills, and ICT engagement tools.
concepts.learning_objective: Design interventions for math deficits, cognitive processing issues, and real-world life skills.

topics.name: Methodology for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
topics.description: Curriculum adaptations, instructional methods, multi-domain evaluation approaches, and co-curricular modifications for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder.

subtopics.name: Curriculum Adaptation and Modification for ASD
subtopics.description: Curriculum development orientation, stages of adaptation, accommodations, and co-curricular focus.

concepts.name: Curriculum Development and Focus for CwASD
concepts.description: Orientation to curriculum development principles and key focal areas for children with ASD.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify key curricular priority areas and design considerations for children on the autism spectrum.

concepts.name: Stages and Types of Adaptations for ASD
concepts.description: Understanding stages of adaptation, structural accommodations, and curricular modifications.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply multi-stage accommodations and modifications tailored to ASD learner characteristics.

concepts.name: Co-curricular Activities and Learning Material Accommodation
concepts.description: Adapting co-curricular activities, structured environment, and learning materials for ASD.
concepts.learning_objective: Modify learning materials and co-curricular settings to ensure active ASD participation.

subtopics.name: Teaching Methods and Multi-Disciplinary Evaluation Approaches for ASD
subtopics.description: Pedagogical methods and behavioral, developmental, cognitive, and social assessment approaches.

concepts.name: Teaching Methods and Instructional Strategies for ASD
concepts.description: Evidence-based teaching approaches and structured instructional techniques for autistic learners.
concepts.learning_objective: Utilize structured teaching strategies and visual supports effectively for ASD students.

concepts.name: Evaluation Approaches for Children with ASD
concepts.description: Evaluation of ASD progress using Behavioral, Developmental, Cognitive, and Social approaches.
concepts.learning_objective: Compare and apply behavioral, developmental, cognitive, and social evaluation methods.

topics.name: Methodology for Cerebral Palsy (CP)
topics.description: Environmental positioning, specialized early childhood models, subject adaptation, motor learning, and Universal Design for Learning for Cerebral Palsy.

subtopics.name: Principles of Teaching, Physical Access, and Classroom Environment
subtopics.description: Reinforcement principles, space/seating/positioning, AAC storage, arousal schedules, and physical considerations.

concepts.name: Teaching Principles, Reinforcement, and TLM Selection
concepts.description: Core teaching principles, reinforcement systems, and selection/use of specialized TLM for CP.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply teaching and reinforcement principles while selecting physical TLM for learners with CP.

concepts.name: Physical Access, Seating, Positioning, and Arousal Schedules
concepts.description: Managing classroom space, seating, positioning, wheelchair/AAC device storage, and arousal-level schedules.
concepts.learning_objective: Arrange classroom environments, seating/positioning setups, and schedules tailored to CP needs.

subtopics.name: Specialized Models, Academic Modifications, and Interventions for CP
subtopics.description: Evaluation frameworks (JASPER, LEAP, ESDM), subject modifications, UDL, social skills, and therapy-aligned strategies.

concepts.name: Specialized Early Childhood and Evaluation Models
concepts.description: Evaluation and intervention frameworks including JASPER, LEAP, and Early Start Denver Model (ESDM).
concepts.learning_objective: Explain early intervention and evaluation models like JASPER, LEAP, and ESDM for children with CP/developmental delays.

concepts.name: Academic Adaptation, Multimedia, and Proficiency Standards
concepts.description: Adapting literacy, numeracy, functional academics, multimedia, and modified proficiency standards/exemptions.
concepts.learning_objective: Modify literacy/numeracy instruction and adjust proficiency standards for CP learners.

concepts.name: Social Skills, Specialized Approaches, and Inclusive UDL
concepts.description: Promoting social skills (Art, Social Stories, Comic strips, Peer-Mediated), Conductive Education, Motor Learning, RTI, and UDL in inclusive elementary classes.
concepts.learning_objective: Implement social skill activities, Conductive Education, RTI, and UDL in regular classrooms for CP inclusion.

topics.name: Methodology for Multiple Disabilities (MD)
topics.description: Aims, principles, sensory impairment approaches, therapeutic interventions, Universal Design for Learning, and computer access for persons with Multiple Disabilities.

subtopics.name: Curriculum, Material Adaptation, and Sensory Strategies for MD
subtopics.description: Curriculum development concepts, material adaptation, and teaching approaches for sensory impairments.

concepts.name: Curriculum Development Aims, Principles, and Types for MD
concepts.description: Aims, concepts, principles, and types/approaches of curriculum development for individuals with multiple disabilities.
concepts.learning_objective: Formulate curriculum aims and design approaches suitable for severe/multiple disabilities.

concepts.name: Curricular and Co-curricular Material Adaptation for MD
concepts.description: Adapting physical, learning, and co-curricular materials for complex needs in MD.
concepts.learning_objective: Adapt learning and co-curricular materials to enable active engagement for children with MD.

concepts.name: Teaching Methods and Strategies for Sensory Impairment
concepts.description: Specialized instructional approaches and techniques for managing concurrent sensory impairments.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply specialized pedagogical techniques for learners with dual or multiple sensory impairments.

subtopics.name: Therapeutic Interventions, Management, and Technology in MD
subtopics.description: Classroom management, evaluation types, therapeutic interventions, UDL, and computer access.

concepts.name: Classroom Management and Evaluation Types in MD
concepts.description: Classroom management techniques and specialized evaluation strategies for students with multiple disabilities.
concepts.learning_objective: Organize classroom management and implement appropriate evaluation types for MD.

concepts.name: Therapeutic Intervention Strategies
concepts.description: Integrating multi-disciplinary therapeutic interventions into educational routines for MD.
concepts.learning_objective: Integrate therapeutic intervention techniques within everyday educational strategies for MD.

concepts.name: Universal Design for Learning (UDL) and Computer Access
concepts.description: Applying Universal Design for Learning principles and adaptive computer access technologies for MD.
concepts.learning_objective: Implement Universal Design for Learning (UDL) frameworks and computer access technologies for MD.
